propositions: Bridge is hardwired to one tracker project at three points (JiraConfig.project scalar, inbound fetcher JQL, outbound guard), blocking teams with multiple projects per codebase

Solution: shared ticket store owns project mapping (.bridge_state/projects.json) alongside bindings.json/prev_snapshot.json, each ticket records its project and repos to avoid cross-project deletion diffs
Ticket project field is tri-state (absent=legacy, explicit-empty=never sync, explicit-key=sync there), resolved via idempotent ensure unit with zero event writes on migration
Multi-project fetch iterates configured project set for base JQL and three enrichment passes (parent/comment/issuelink), merging results into shared snapshot keyed by issue
Outbound dispatch respects per-ticket project on create; guard relaxed from single project to set membership, refusing CrossProjectTargetError only for projects outside configured set

Store-compat capability stamp adds multi-project-bridge to required_capabilities when mapping holds >1 project; binaries lacking capability refuse writes; atomic commit ensures mapping and stamp land together
